title: SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO Details
intro:
SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is a book build issue of ₹42.52 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 32.56 lakh shares aggregating to ₹38.42 crores and offer for sale of 3.48 lakh shares aggregating to ₹4.11 crores.

SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO opens for subscription on Sep 17, 2026 and closes on Sep 21, 2026. The allotment for the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 22, 2026. SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 24, 2026.

SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is set issue price band at ₹112 to ₹118 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,83,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,24,800.

Indcap Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Asnani Stock Broker Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in January 2009, SpectraA Technology Solutions Limited is an engineering and technology solutions provider engaged in the design, fabrication, installation, commissioning and decommissioning of greenfield and brownfield projects. The Company undertakes projects from engineering and design to fabrication, installation, commissioning and handover, with in-house manufacturing of key equipment and customised process plant systems. Its product portfolio includes commercial brewery equipment, distillery equipment, food and beverage plants, microbrewery equipment, malt spirit equipment and extraction plants. The Company also uses standardised modules and designs and deploys dedicated project teams at client sites to support timely project execution and cost control.

The Company has built process systems in accordance with ISO 9001:2015 and undertakes customised projects based on customer specifications. Its solutions are used for applications including beer brewing, fermentation, distillation, spirit production, extraction of flavours and colours from plant-based inputs, and processing of food and beverage products.

The Company operates two manufacturing facilities located in Bengaluru and Jaipur, with an aggregate built-up area of approximately 33,215 sq. ft. It follows a dual-sourcing approach for critical inputs and develops local vendor bases around its manufacturing hubs to support procurement and project schedules. The Company has also installed an aggregate 100 kWp rooftop solar capacity across its Malur plant, Jaipur plant and registered office, supporting reduction in power costs.

The Company has completed projects across various industries and maintains a diversified order book covering breweries, distilleries, food and beverages, malt spirit and blending, extraction plants, FMCG and pharmaceuticals.

As of August 31, 2026, the Company had 79 employees across management, sales, accounts, project and site operations, production, purchase, design and engineering, electrical, logistics and other functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
